1: Sirf Allah hi aisa hai, jis ne aasmaano aur zameen ko adam se paida kiya, jo tamam kamaal ke saath bayan kiya jata hai, jis ki buland tareen sifaat par taarif ki jati hai, aur jis se mohabbat ka haqq hai. Usi ne raat aur din banaye, jo ek doosre ke peeche aate hain. Us ne raat andhere ke liye banayi aur din roshni ke liye. Is sab ke baawajood Us ke kuch bande Us ka inkaar karte hain aur Us ke saath doosron ko sharik thehrate hain. Allah un ki baaton se bahut buland hai.
2: Aey logo, Wohi, paak hai Woh, jis ne tumhein mitti se paida kiya, jab Us ne tumhare baap Adam (alaihis salaam) ko us se banaya. Phir Us ne, paak hai Woh, duniya ki zindagi mein tumhare rehne ka ek waqt muqarrar kiya. Aur Us ne ek aur waqt bhi muqarrar kiya, jise sirf Woh hi jaanta hai, jab Woh tumhein Qayamat ke din dobara zinda karega. Is ke baawajood tum ab bhi Us ke dobara zinda karne ki qudrat mein shak karte ho.
3: Wohi, paak hai Woh, aasmaano aur zameen mein ibadat ka haqdaar hai. Woh un niyaton, baaton aur aamaal ko jaanta hai jo tum chhipate ho aur jo tum zaahir karte ho; aur Woh un ke baare mein tumhara faisla karega.
4: Mushrikon ke paas un ke Rubb ki taraf se koi daleel ya mojiza aisa nahin aata jise woh bina kisi tawajjuh ke nazar-andaaz na kar dein. Un ke paas ab Allah ke yakta hone ki khuli dalilein aur suboot aa chuke hain, aur rasoolon ki sachhaai ke mojize bhi; phir bhi unhon ne munh moad liya aur in nishaniyon aur mojizon par koi dhyaan na diya.
5: Aur jis tarah unhon ne in khuli dalilon aur subooton se munh moad liya, usi tarah woh is se pehle us se bhi zyada wazeh cheez se munh moad chuke the: unhon ne us Quran ko jhutlaya jo Muhammad ﷺ laaye. Woh jald jaan lenge, jab Qayamat ke din azaab dekhenge, ke jis cheez ka woh mazaaq udate the aur jo woh un ke paas laaye the, woh haqeeqat mein haqq thi.
6: Kya yeh kafir Allah ka woh dastoor nahin jaante ke Woh zulm karne wali ummaton ko halak kar deta hai? Allah ne in se pehle bahut si aisi ummatein halak ki hain jinhein Us ne zameen mein in se zyada mazbooti se jamaya tha. Allah ne un par lagatar baarishein barsayin aur un ke gharon ke neeche nahrein chalayin; phir bhi woh Us ke khilaaf gaye, to Us ne unhein un gunahon ki wajah se halak kar diya jo woh karte the. Phir un ke baad Us ne doosri ummatein qayam kein.
7: Aey Rasool, agar Hum aap par kaagaz par likhi hui koi kitab utaar dete aur woh use apni aankhon se dekh lete, to bhi woh hath-dharmi aur inkaar ki wajah se use qabool na karte; aur kehte: 'Jo aap laaye hain woh khule jaadu ke siwa kuch nahin; aur hum is par kabhi iman nahin laayenge.'
8: In kafiron ne kaha: 'Hum iman laayenge agar Allah Muhammad ﷺ ke saath koi farishta utaar de jo hum se baat kare aur gawahi de ke yeh rasool hain.' Agar Hum un ki marzi ka farishta utaar dein, to agar woh phir bhi iman na laaye to Hum unhein halak kar denge; aur unhein tauba ka waqt nahin diya jayega.
9: Aur agar Main un ki taraf koi farishta bhejta, to use aadmi ki shakal mein banata, taake woh us ki baat sun sakein aur us se seekh sakein, kyunke woh us asli shakal mein farishte se nahin seekh sakte jis mein Maine use paida kiya. Aur agar Main use aadmi ki shakal mein banata, to woh us ke baare mein uljhan mein pad jate.
10: Agar yeh log aap ka mazaaq udate hain ke aap ke saath koi farishta kyun nahin utaara gaya, to pehli ummaton ne bhi apne rasoolon ka mazaaq udaya tha. Phir woh azaab unhein gher kar rah gaya jise woh jhutlate the aur jis ka mazaaq udate the jab unhein us se daraya jata tha.
11: Aey Rasool, in jhutlane walon aur mazaaq udane walon se keh dijiye: zameen mein chalo phiro, phir soch kar dekho ke un logon ka kya anjaam hua jinhon ne Allah ke rasoolon ka inkaar kiya. Un par Allah ka azaab aaya, halanke woh taaqat aur zor ke muqaam par the.
12: Aey Rasool, in se poochiye: 'Aasmaano aur zameen ki, aur jo kuch in ke darmiyan hai us ki baadshahat kis ki hai?' Keh dijiye: in sab par poora ikhtiyar Allah hi ka hai. Us ne apne bandon par fazl karte hue apne oopar rehmat laazim kar li hai, is liye Woh unhein saza dene mein jaldi nahin karega. Phir agar woh tauba na karein, to Woh unhein Qayamat ke din jama karega, jis din mein koi shak nahin. Jin logon ne apne aap ko kufr se halakat tak pahuncha kar apni jaanein gawa deen, woh iman nahin laayenge aur apni jaanein is ghaate se nahin bacha sakenge.
13: Har cheez ki baadshahat sirf Allah hi ki hai. Jo kuch raat mein chhipa rahta hai aur jo kuch din mein khule-aam chalta phirta hai, sab Us ke bande aur Us ki makhlooq hain: sab Us ke qaaboo aur Us ke ikhtiyar mein hain. Woh un ki baatein sunta hai aur un ke aamaal jaanta hai, aur un ke mutabiq faisla karega.
14: Aey Rasool, un mushrikon se keh dijiye jo Allah ke saath buton aur doosri cheezon ki ibadat karte hain: kya yeh baat samajh mein aati hai ke main Allah ke siwa kisi aur ko apna kaar-saaz aur hifazat karne wala banaoon, jis se madad maangoon? Allah hi hai jis ne aasmaano aur zameen ko bina kisi pehli misaal ke paida kiya. Us se pehle koi Khaaliq nahin tha. Wohi apne bandon mein se jis ko chahe rozi deta hai, aur Us ke bandon mein se koi Use rozi nahin deta. Woh apne bandon ka mohtaaj nahin, balke Us ke bande Us ke mohtaaj hain. Aey Rasool, keh dijiye: mere Rubb ne mujhe hukm diya hai ke is ummat mein sab se pehle main jhuk jaoon aur apne aap ko Us ke hawale kar doon. Aur Us ne mujhe is se roka hai ke main un logon mein se ho jaoon jo Us ke saath doosron ko sharik thehrate hain.
15: Aey Rasool, keh dijiye: agar main Allah ki nafarmani karoon aur woh kaam karoon jo Us ne mana kiye, jaise Us ke saath kisi ko sharik thehrana, ya woh chhod doon jis ka Us ne mujhe hukm diya, jaise iman aur neik aamaal, to mujhe dar hai ke Woh mujhe Qayamat ke din sakht azaab dega.
16: Jis shaks se Allah Qayamat ke din azaab hata de aur door kar de, us ne Allah ki rehmat se kaamyabi paa li. Azaab se yeh nijaat aur yeh aman ek khuli fatah hai, jis ke barabar koi doosri fatah nahin.
17: Aey Adam (alaihis salaam) ki aulaad, agar Allah ki taraf se tum par koi museebat aa jaye, to Allah ke siwa koi nahin jo use tum se hata sake. Aur agar Us ki taraf se tumhein koi bhalai pahunche, to koi nahin jo Use is se rok sake. Allah ke fazl ko koi rok nahin sakta. Woh har cheez par qudrat rakhta hai aur koi Us par ghalib nahin aa sakta.
18: Wohi hai jo Qudrat wala aur Ghalib hai, aur koi Us par ghalib nahin aa sakta aur na Use shikast de sakta hai: har cheez Us ke taabe hai. Woh apne bandon ke oopar hai, aisi shaan ke saath jo Us ke laayak hai, paak hai Woh. Woh apni takhleeq, apne intezam aur apne ahkaam mein Hikmat wala hai. Aur Woh khoob khabar rakhne wala hai, Us se kuch chhipa nahin.
19: Aey Rasool, un mushrikon se keh dijiye jo aap ko jhutlate hain: gawahi mein sab se bari aur sab se mohtaram cheez kaun si hai jo meri sachhaai par gawah ho? Keh dijiye: meri sachhaai ka sab se bada aur sab se mohtaram gawah Allah hai. Woh mere aur tumhare darmiyan gawah hai. Woh jaanta hai ke main tumhare paas kya laaya hoon aur tum kya jawab dete ho. Allah ne mujh par yeh Quran utara hai, taake main is ke zariye tumhein daraaoon aur har us insaan aur jinn ko bhi jis tak yeh pahunche. Aey mushriko, tum yeh maante ho ke Allah ke saath kuch aur bhi ibadat ke laayak hain. Aey Rasool, keh dijiye: jis baat ka tum ne iqrar kiya, main us ki gawahi nahin deta, kyunke woh baatil hai. Allah to bas ek hi maabood hai, Us ka koi sharik nahin, aur jo kuch tum Us ka sharik thehrate ho, main us sab se bezaar hoon.
20: Jin Yahudiyon ko Taurat di gayi aur jin Nasara ko Injeel di gayi, woh Nabi Muhammad ﷺ ko poori tarah pehchante hain, jaise woh apne bachchon ko doosre bachchon se pehchante hain. Yahi log hain jinhon ne apne aap ko Jahannam ki aag mein daal kar apni jaanein gawa deen, aur woh iman nahin laayenge.
21: Sab se bada zaalim woh shaks hai jo Allah ke saath kisi ko sharik thehraye aur Allah ke saath us ki ibadat kare, ya woh shaks jo Allah ki un aayaton ko jhutlaye jo Us ne apne Rasool par utari. Jo log Allah ke saath sharik thehra kar aur Us ki aayaton ko jhutla kar zulm karte hain, woh kabhi kaamyab nahin honge, agar tauba na karein.
22: Aur Qayamat ka woh din yaad karo jab Main un sab ko jama karoonga, un mein se kisi ko nahin chhodoonga, aur un logon se poochoonga jo Allah ke siwa doosron ki ibadat karte the: 'Kahan hain tumhare woh sharik jinhein tum Allah ka sharik kehte the?'
23: Is aazmaish ke baad un ke paas koi uzr nahin hoga, aur woh un cheezon se bezaari ka izhar karenge jin ki woh ibadat karte the, aur jhoot kehte hue bolenge: Aey Allah, hamare Rubb, hum ne duniya mein tere saath kisi ko sharik nahin thehraya; balke hum tujh par iman rakhte the aur tere yakta hone ka iqrar karte the.
24: Aey Muhammad ﷺ, dekhiye in logon ne apne baare mein kaisa jhoot bola aur is baat se inkaar kar diya ke woh Allah ke saath kisi ko sharik thehrate the. Jin sharikon ko unhon ne duniya ki zindagi mein Allah ka sharik banaya tha, woh sab gaayab ho gaye aur unhein chhod gaye.
25: Aey Rasool, kuch mushrik aap ki baat sunte hain jab aap Quran padhte hain, magar woh jo sunte hain us se faida nahin uthate, kyunke Maine un ke dilon par parde daal diye hain, is liye woh Quran ko samajh nahin sakte. Maine aisa un ki hath-dharmi aur un ke munh modne ki wajah se kiya. Aur Maine un ke kaan faide wali baat sunne se behre kar diye. Un khuli nishaniyon aur roshan dalilon ke baawajood jo woh dekhte hain, woh phir bhi iman nahin laate, yahan tak ke jab woh aap ke paas aate hain to haqq ke khilaaf jhooti baatein pesh karte hain aur kehte hain: jo aap laaye hain woh to bas pehle logon ki kitabon se liya gaya hai.
26: Yeh mushrik logon ko Rasool ko maanne se rokte hain jaise woh khud is se door rehte hain: woh na khud faida uthate hain aur na doosron ko uthane dete hain. Aisa karke woh sirf apne aap ko halak karte hain; magar unhein yeh ehsaas nahin ke woh apni halakat laa rahe hain.
27: Aey Rasool, agar aap unhein us waqt dekh paate jab woh Qayamat ke din Jahannam ki aag ke saamne khade kiye jayenge, aur pachtate hue kahenge: 'Kaash humein duniya mein wapas bhej diya jaye, to hum Allah ki aayaton ko na jhutlayein aur un logon mein se ho jayein jo Allah par iman laaye,' to aap un ki pareshani ka ek ajeeb manzar dekhte.
28: Un ka yeh kehna ke wapas bhej diye jayein to iman laa lenge, jhoot hai. Balke jo baat woh chhipaya karte the, yani 'Allah ki qasam, hum mushrik nahin the', woh un par khul chuki hogi jab un ke aazaa un ke khilaaf gawahi denge. Aur agar unhein waqai duniya mein wapas bhej diya jaye, to woh usi kufr aur shirk ki taraf laut jayenge jis se unhein roka gaya tha. Lihaza woh apne is wade mein jhoote hain ke wapas bhej diye jaane par iman laayenge.
29: Yeh mushrik kehte hain: 'Is zindagi ke siwa koi zindagi nahin jo ab hamein hai, aur hum hisaab ke liye dobara nahin uthaye jayenge.'
30: Aey Rasool, agar aap us waqt dekh paate jab dobara zinda hone ka inkaar karne wale apne Rubb ke saamne khade kiye jayenge, to aap un ki pareshani ka ek ajeeb manzar dekhte, jab Allah un se kahega: kya yeh dobara zinda hona haqq nahin, jis ka tum inkaar karte the aur jis mein koi shak nahin? Woh kahenge: hum apne us Rubb ki qasam khaate hain jis ne humein paida kiya, yeh yaqeenan haqq hai aur is mein koi shak nahin. Phir Allah un se kahega: to ab us azaab ka maza chakho jo is din ke jhutlane ka natija hai, jise tum duniya ki zindagi mein rad karte the.
31: Jo log Qayamat ke din dobara zinda hone ka inkaar karte hain aur Allah ke saamne khade hone ko door ki baat samajhte hain, woh khule ghaate mein hain. Yahan tak ke jab Qayamat achanak un par aa padegi, bina kisi pehle ilm ke, to woh shiddat ke afsos se kahenge: haaye hamari barbaadi aur hamari mayoosi, ke hum Allah se gaafil rahe, Us ka inkaar kiya aur Qayamat ke din ki koi tayyari na ki. Aur woh apne bure aamaal apni peethon par uthaye hue honge. Jo bure aamaal woh uthaye hue hain, woh kitne bure hain!
32: Duniya ki zindagi, jis ki taraf tum jhukte ho, us shaks ke liye khel aur dhoke ke siwa kuch nahin jo Allah ki razamandi ke liye amal nahin karta. Aur Aakhirat ka ghar un logon ke liye behtar hai jo Allah se darte hain: jo kaam Us ne diya woh karte hain, jaise iman aur Us ki itaat, aur jis se Us ne roka us se bachte hain, jaise Us ke saath sharik thehrana aur gunah. Aey mushriko, kya tum yeh baat nahin samajhte, taake iman laao aur neik kaam karo?
33: Aey Rasool, Main jaanta hoon ke un ka aap ko zaahir mein jhutlana aap ko dukh deta hai. Jaan lijiye ke andar se woh aap ko nahin jhutlate, kyunke woh aap ki sachhaai aur aap ki amanat-daari jaante hain. Balke woh aise log hain jo zulm karte hain, kyunke woh Allah ki aayaton ko rad karte hain, isi liye woh aap ki laayi hui baat ko na-pasand karte hain aur zaahir mein us ka inkaar karte hain.
34: Aur yeh na samjhiye ke yeh jhutlana sirf aap ki laayi hui baat ke saath hai. Aap se pehle ke rasoolon ko bhi un ki qaumon ne jhutlaya aur unhein takleef pahunchayi, magar unhon ne Allah ki taraf bulane aur Us ki raah mein koshish karne mein is par sabr kiya, yahan tak ke un ke paas Allah ki madad aa gayi. Aur jo madad Allah ne apne rasoolon ke liye likh di aur un se wada kiya, use koi rok nahin sakta. Aey Rasool, aap se pehle ke rasoolon ki khabar aur un mushkilaat ki khabar bhi aap tak pahunch chuki hai jo unhein apni qaumon se pesh aayin, aur us madad ki khabar bhi jo Allah ne unhein di, ke un ke dushmanon ko halak kar diya.
35: Aey Rasool, agar un ka aap ki laayi hui baat ko jhutlana aur us se munh modna aap par bhari hai, to dekh lijiye ke kya aap zameen mein koi surang paa sakte hain ya aasman mein koi seedhi, taake aap un ke paas us se mazeed daleel laa sakein jo Main aap ko pehle de chuka hoon. Aur agar Allah chahta ke unhein us hidayat par le aaye jo aap laaye hain, to Woh aisa kar deta. Magar apni hikmat ki wajah se Us ne aisa nahin chaaha. Lihaza aap un logon mein se na hon jo is baat se na-waaqif hain, aur un ke jhutlane ke gam mein apne aap ko na ghulayein.
36: Aap ki laayi hui baat ko sirf wahi log maanenge jo baat sunte hain aur use samajhte hain. Aur kafir murdon ki tarah hain, be-kaar, kyunke un ke dil mar chuke hain. Allah murdon ko Qayamat ke din uthayega, phir woh Usi ki taraf lautaye jayenge taake Woh un ke aamaal ka badla de.
37: Mushrik hath-dharmi se mutalbe karte hain aur iman laane mein der karte hain, aur kehte hain: Muhammad ﷺ par un ke Rubb ki taraf se koi anokhi nishani kyun nahin utari gayi jo un ki laayi hui baat ki sachhaai ki daleel ho? Aey Rasool, keh dijiye: Allah aisi nishani utaarne par qaadir hai jaisi tum chahte ho, magar in mushrikon mein se aksar, jo nishani utarne ka mutalba karte hain, yeh nahin jaante ke nishaniyan sirf Allah ki hikmat ke mutabiq utari jati hain, un ke mutalbe ke mutabiq nahin. Aur agar Woh use utaar deta aur phir bhi woh iman na laate, to Woh unhein halak kar deta.
38: Aey Adam (alaihis salaam) ki aulaad, zameen par koi jaanwar aisa nahin aur na aasman mein udne wala koi parinda, magar yeh ke woh apni paidaish aur apni rozi mein tum hi jaise giroh hain. Maine Lauh-e-Mehfooz mein koi cheez nahin chhodi. In sab ka ilm Allah ke paas hai. Phir yeh sab Qayamat ke din aakhiri faisle ke liye apne Rubb ke paas jama kiye jayenge, aur har ek ko wahi badla milega jis ka woh haqdaar hai.
39: Jo log Hamari aayaton ko jhutlate hain, woh un logon jaise hain jo behre hain aur sun nahin sakte, aur un jaise jo goonge hain aur bol nahin sakte. Aur is ke saath woh poore andhere mein hain, jis mein woh dekh nahin sakte. Phir aisa shaks hidayat kaise paaye? Allah logon mein se jis ko chahe gumraah kar deta hai, aur jis ko chahe hidayat deta hai aur use aise seedhe raaste par rakh deta hai jis mein koi tedhapan nahin.
40: Aey Rasool, in mushrikon se keh dijiye: mujhe batao, agar tum par Allah ki taraf se koi azaab aa jaye, ya woh Qayamat aa jaye jis ka tum se wada kiya gaya hai, to kya us waqt tum us museebat aur mushkil ko hatane ke liye Allah ke siwa kisi aur ko pukaroge? Yeh us soorat mein hai jab tum is daawe mein sachche ho ke jin ki tum ibadat karte ho woh faida pahuncha sakte hain aur nuqsan hata sakte hain.
41: Haqeeqat yeh hai ke jab Qayamat aayegi to tum us Allah ke siwa kisi ko nahin pukaroge jis ne tumhein paida kiya, aur Woh woh museebat hata dega aur nuqsan door kar dega, kyunke Wohi is ka haqdaar hai aur is par qaadir hai, agar Woh chahe. Aur jinhein tum maabood maan kar poojte the, unhein tum chhod doge, kyunke tum jaan loge ke woh na faida pahuncha sakte hain aur na nuqsan.
42: Aey Rasool, Maine aap se pehle bahut si ummaton ki taraf rasool bheje, magar un ummaton ne apne rasoolon ko jhutlaya aur un ki laayi hui baat se munh moad liya. Phir Maine unhein tangi aur beemari se aazmaya, taake woh apne Rubb ke saamne jhuk jayein aur aajizi karein.
43: Kaash woh Allah ke saamne jhuk jate jab Us ki taraf se un par museebat aayi, aur Allah se giggid kar maangte ke woh museebat hata de, to Woh un par reham karta. Magar unhon ne aisa nahin kiya. Balke un ke dil sakht ho gaye aur unhon ne koi dhyaan na diya aur koi sabaq na liya. Aur shaytan ne un ke liye woh kufr aur gunah khoobsurat bana diye jo woh karte the, is liye woh un hi kaamon par jame rahe.
44: Phir jab unhon ne sakht tangi aur beemari ki tambeeh ko nazar-andaaz kar diya aur Allah ke ahkaam par na chale, to Us ne un par rozi ke darwaze khol kar unhein haqq se aur door kheench liya, aur unhein tangi ke baad maal diya. Aur beemari ke baad unhein achhi sehat bhi di. Yeh silsila us waqt tak chalta raha jab tak woh apne gurur aur zindagi ke maze mein doob na gaye; phir Us ka azaab achanak un par aa gaya, aur woh mayoosi mein gher liye gaye aur har umeed kho baithe.
45: Is tarah kafiron ki jad kaat di gayi aur woh poori tarah mita diye gaye, jab Allah ke rasoolon ko madad mil gayi. Aur tamam shukr aur taarif sirf Allah hi ke liye hai, jo tamam jahanon ka Rubb hai, ke Us ne apne dushmanon ko halak kiya aur apne doston ki madad ki.
46: Aey Rasool, in mushrikon se keh dijiye: mujhe batao, agar Allah tumhari sunne ki taaqat le kar tumhein behra kar de, tumhari aankhein le kar tumhein andha kar de, aur tumhare dilon par mohar laga de ke tum kuch na samjho, to Allah ke siwa kaun sa maabood hai jo yeh sab tumhein lauta de? Aey Rasool, gaur kijiye ke Hum un ke saamne dalilein kis kis tarah khol kar rakhte hain, phir bhi woh un se munh moad lete hain.
47: Keh dijiye: mujhe batao, agar Allah ka azaab tum par achanak aa jaye, bina is ke ke tumhein khabar ho, ya tumhari aankhon ke saamne khule-aam aa jaye, to kya aisa nahin ke sirf wahi log halak honge jo Allah aur Us ke rasoolon ka inkaar karke zulm karte hain, aur sirf wahi bachenge jo Allah par iman laate hain aur Us ke rasoolon ki pairvi karte hain?
48: Main apne rasoolon ko sirf is liye bhejta hoon ke iman aur itaat walon ko us hamesha rehne wali naimat ki khush-khabri dein jo kabhi khatam nahin hogi, aur kufr aur gunah walon ko Mere sakht azaab se daraayein. Phir jo rasoolon ko maan le aur apne aamaal durust kar le, use Aakhirat mein aane wali cheez ka koi khauf nahin hoga, aur na duniya ke un mazon ka gam jo us se chhoot gaye.
49: Aur jo log Hamari aayaton ko jhutlate hain, unhein azaab aa pakdega, kyunke unhon ne Allah ki mukhalifat ki. Agar woh Us ke khilaaf na jate, balke Us ke ahkaam poore karte aur Us ki mana ki hui cheezon se bachte, to unhein azaab na pahunchta.
50: Aey Rasool, in mushrikon se keh dijiye: main tum se yeh nahin kehta ke mere paas Allah ke rozi ke khazane hain aur main un mein jo chahoon kar sakta hoon. Aur main tum se yeh bhi nahin kehta ke main gaib jaanta hoon, siwaye us wahi ke jo Allah ne mujh par zaahir ki. Aur main tum se yeh bhi nahin kehta ke main farishta hoon. Main Allah ka Rasool hoon aur sirf us ki pairvi karta hoon jo meri taraf wahi ki jati hai. Main woh daawa nahin karta jo mere laayak nahin. Kya woh kafir, jis ki nazar haqq se andhi hai, us momin ke barabar hai jo haqq ko dekhta hai aur us par iman rakhta hai? Aey mushriko, kya tum apne aas-paas ki nishaniyon par gaur nahin karte?
51: Aey Rasool, is Quran ke zariye un logon ko daraaiye jinhein dar hai ke woh Qayamat ke din apne Rubb ke paas jama kiye jayenge, jab Allah ke siwa un ka na koi dost hoga jo unhein faida pahunchaye aur na koi sifarish karne wala jo un se nuqsan hataye, taake woh Allah se darein: Us ke hukm par chalein aur Us ki mana ki hui cheezon se bachein. Yahi log hain jo Quran se faida uthayenge.
52: Aey Rasool, un gareeb musalmanon ko apni majlis se na hatayein jo subah aur shaam khulus ke saath Allah ki ibadat karte hain. Mushrikon ke sardaron ki khushi haasil karne ke liye unhein dur na bhagayein. In gareebon ke aamaal ka aap se koi hisaab nahin. Un ka hisaab sirf Allah lega. Aur isi tarah aap ke aamaal ka un se koi hisaab nahin. Agar aap unhein apni majlis se nikaal dein, to aap un logon mein se ho jayenge jo Allah ki hadein phaand jate hain.
53: Chunanche Maine unhein ek doosre ke zariye aazmaya. Maine kuch ko maaldaar banaya aur kuch ko gareeb. Maine unhein duniyavi haalat mein alag alag rakha. Maine unhein is liye aazmaya ke maaldaar kafir gareeb mominon ke baare mein kahein: kya yahi woh gareeb log hain jin par Allah ne hum mein se hidayat ka ehsan kiya? Agar yeh deen koi achhi cheez hota, to yeh log is mein hum se aage na nikal jate, kyunke hum hi hain jo pehle aate hain. Kya Allah un logon ko nahin jaanta jo Us ki naimaton ka shukr ada karte hain, is liye Woh unhein iman ki hidayat deta hai, aur un ko bhi jo in naimaton ka inkaar karte hain, is liye Woh unhein kufr mein chhod deta hai? Be-shak Allah unhein khoob jaanta hai.
54: Aey Rasool, jab aap ke paas woh log aayein jo Meri un aayaton ko maante hain jo aap ki laayi hui baat ki sachhaai batati hain, to un ki izzat mein un ke salaam ka jawab dijiye aur unhein Meri rehmat ki khush-khabri dijiye. Maine apne fazl se rehmat apne oopar laazim kar li hai. Phir tum mein se jo koi na-waaqfiyat aur nadani mein gunah kar bethe, aur phir us gunah se tauba kar le aur apne aamaal durust kar le, to Main use maaf kar doonga, kyunke Main apne us bande ke liye Bakhshne wala aur Meharban hoon jo Meri taraf tauba karta hai.
55: Aur jis tarah Maine pichli baatein khol kar bayan kein, usi tarah Main tumhare liye Quran khol kar bayan karta hoon, taake haqq wazeh ho jaye aur us par amal kiya jaye; aur taake mujrimon ka raasta bhi wazeh ho jaye, taake us se bacha jaye.
56: Aey Rasool, keh dijiye: 'Allah ne mujhe un ki ibadat se roka hai jin ki tum Us ke siwa ibadat karte ho.' Aey Rasool, keh dijiye: main Allah ke siwa kisi aur ki ibadat mein tumhari khwahishon ke peeche nahin chalta. Agar main tumhari khwahishon ke peeche chalta, to haqq ke raaste se bhatak jata aur us ki hidayat na paata. Aur yahi haal har us shaks ka hai jo Allah ki taraf se kisi daleel ke baghair apni khwahish ke peeche chalta hai.
57: Aey Rasool, in mushrikon se keh dijiye: main apne Rubb ki taraf se ek khuli daleel par khada hoon, kisi khwahish par nahin, phir bhi tum ne is daleel ko jhutlaya. Aur woh azaab aur woh anokhi nishaniyan mere paas nahin jin ka tum mutalba karte ho aur jinhein laane ki tumhein itni jaldi hai. Yeh sirf Allah ke ikhtiyar mein hai. Har cheez ka faisla, jis mein tumhara mutalba bhi hai, sirf Allah ka hai. Woh haqq kehta hai aur usi ke mutabiq faisla karta hai. Allah, paak hai Woh, haqq aur baatil mein faisla karne walon mein sab se behtar hai.
58: Aey Rasool, in se keh dijiye: agar woh azaab mere ikhtiyar mein hota jise laane ki tumhein itni jaldi hai, to main use tum par utaar deta. Aur agar aisa ho jata, to mere aur tumhare darmiyan maamla tai ho jata. Allah hi behtar jaanta hai ke zaalimon ko kitni mohlat deni hai, aur Wohi behtar jaanta hai ke unhein kab azaab dena hai.
59: Gaib ke khazane sirf Allah ke paas hain: Us ke siwa unhein koi nahin jaanta. Woh khushki ki tamam makhlooq ko jaanta hai, jaise jaanwar, podey aur be-jaan cheezein. Aur jo jaanwar ya podey samundar mein hain, woh unhein bhi jaanta hai. Kisi jagah koi patta nahin girta, aur na zameen mein chhipa koi daana hai, aur na koi tar ya khushk cheez, magar yeh ke woh ek khuli kitab mein likhi hui hai, jo Lauh-e-Mehfooz hai.
60: Allah hi hai jo raat ko, jab tum sote ho, tumhari jaanein kuch waqt ke liye le leta hai, aur Wohi jaanta hai ke tum din mein jaagte hue kya kaam karte ho. Phir Woh tumhein din mein uthata hai, neend ke zariye tumhari jaanein lene ke baad, taake tum apne kaam poore karo. Yeh silsila us waqt tak chalta rahega jab tak tumhari zindagi ka woh muqarrar waqt poora na ho jaye jo Allah ko maaloom hai. Phir tum sirf Usi ki taraf lautoge, jab Woh tumhein Qayamat ke din uthayega. Us waqt Woh tumhein bata dega ke tum duniya ki zindagi mein kya karte the, aur tumhare aamaal ka badla dega.
61: Aur Allah hi hai jo Ghalib aur Qaahir hai, jis ke taabe har cheez hai. Woh apne bandon ke oopar hai, aisi shaan ke saath jo Us ki azmat ke laayak hai, paak hai Woh. Aey logo, Woh tum par izzat wale farishte bhejta hai jo tumhare aamaal likhte hain. Yeh silsila us waqt tak chalta hai jab tak maut ka farishta aur us ke madadgaar kisi shaks ki zindagi khatam karke us ki jaan nahin nikaal lete. Aur maut ka farishta aur us ke madadgaar jo hukm unhein diya jata hai use poora karne mein kabhi kotahi nahin karte.
62: Phir jin ki jaanein nikaali gayin, woh sab Allah ki taraf lautaye jayenge, jo un ka asli maalik hai, taake Woh un ke aamaal ka badla de. Faisla karne ka ikhtiyar aur un ke darmiyan insaaf se faisla karna Usi ka hai. Aur Woh hisaab lene walon mein sab se jald hai, kyunke Woh un sab ka hisaab ek hi din mein le lega.
63: Aey Rasool, in mushrikon se keh dijiye: kaun hai jo tumhein museebat se bachata aur nijaat deta hai? Tum sirf Usi ko pukarte ho, chhup kar bhi aur khule-aam bhi aajizi karte hue, aur kehte ho: agar hamara Rubb humein is halakat se bacha le to hum zaroor un logon mein se honge jo Us ki naimaton ka shukr ada karte hain, aur hum Us ke siwa kisi ki ibadat nahin karenge.
64: Aey Rasool, in se keh dijiye: 'Allah hi hai jo tumhein is se bachata hai aur har takleef se nijaat deta hai. Phir bhi, jab tum achhe haal mein hote ho, tum Us ke saath doosron ko sharik thehrate ho. Is se badh kar galat kya ho sakta hai?'
65: Aey Rasool, in se keh dijiye: Allah is par qaadir hai ke tum par aisa azaab bheje jo tumhare oopar se aaye, jaise pathraav, bijli aur sailab; ya jo tumhare neeche se aaye, jaise zalzale aur zameen mein dhans jana. Aur Woh tumhare dilon mein phoot bhi daal sakta hai, ke har shaks apni khwahish ke peeche chale aur tum aapas mein lado. Aey Rasool, gaur kijiye ke Main un ke saamne dalilein kis kis tarah khol kar rakhta hoon, taake woh samjhein ke jo aap un ke paas laaye hain woh haqq hai, aur jo un ke paas hai woh baatil.
66: Aap ki qaum ne is Quran ko jhutlaya, halanke yeh haqq hai aur is mein koi shak nahin ke yeh Allah ki taraf se hai. Aey Rasool, in se keh dijiye: main tumhare aamaal ka zimmedaar nahin. Meri zimmedaari sirf yeh hai ke sakht azaab se pehle tumhein daraa doon.
67: Har baat ka ek waqt hai jis mein woh hoti hai aur ek anjaam jis tak woh pahunchti hai. Is mein tumhare anjaam bhi shaamil hain. Tum unhein jald jaan loge jab Qayamat ke din uthaye jaoge.
68: Aey Rasool, jab aap mushrikon ko Meri aayaton ke baare mein mazaaq ke taur par baat karte dekhein, to un ke saath na bethein jab tak woh koi aur baat shuru na kar dein jis mein yeh mazaaq na ho. Aur agar shaytan aap ko bhula de aur aap un ke saath beth jayein aur phir yaad aa jaye, to us majlis se uth jaiye aur un logon ke saath na bethiye jo hadein phaand jate hain.
69: Jo log Allah se darte hain, Us ke hukm par chalte hain aur Us ki mana ki hui cheezon se bachte hain, un zaalimon ke hisaab ki koi cheez un par nahin. Un ki zimmedaari sirf itni hai ke unhein us burai se rokein jo woh kar rahe hain, taake woh bhi Allah se darein, Us ke hukm par chalein aur Us ki mana ki hui cheezon se bachein.
70: Aey Rasool, in mushrikon ko chhod dijiye jinhon ne apne deen ko khel aur dil-lagi bana rakha hai aur jo us ka mazaaq udate hain. Duniya ki zindagi aur us ke waqti mazon ne unhein dhoke mein daal rakha hai. Aey Nabi, is Quran ke zariye logon ko nasihat kijiye, taake koi jaan un bure aamaal ki wajah se halakat ke hawale na ho jaye jo us ne kiye. Agar us ne aisa kiya, to Qayamat ke din na koi us ki madad karne wala hoga aur na koi sifarish karne wala jo use Allah ke azaab se bachaye. Aur agar woh Allah ke azaab se bachne ke liye koi fidya de, to woh us se qabool nahin kiya jayega. Yahi woh log hain jo apne kiye gunahon ki wajah se halakat ke hawale kar diye gaye. Qayamat ke din unhein peene ko ek nihayat garam cheez milegi aur un ke kufr ki wajah se dardnaak azaab.
71: Aey Rasool, in mushrikon se keh dijiye: kya hum Allah ko chhod kar aise buton ki ibadat karein jo na humein koi faida pahuncha sakte hain aur na nuqsan? Kya hum iman ke baad ulte paon phir jayein, jab ke Allah ne humein us ki hidayat di? Agar hum aisa karein, to hum us shaks jaise honge jise shaytanon ne bhatka diya ho: woh uljhan mein pada hai, use seedha raasta nahin soojhta; aur us ke saathi seedhe raaste par hain jo use haqq ki taraf bulate hain, magar woh un ki pukar maanne se inkaar karta hai. Aey Rasool, in se keh dijiye: Allah ki hidayat hi sachchi hidayat hai, aur Us ne humein hukm diya hai ke hum Us ke saamne jhuk jayein, paak hai Woh: Us ke yakta hone par pakke rahein aur sirf Usi ki ibadat karein, kyunke Wohi tamam jahanon ka Rubb hai.
72: Aur mujhe hukm diya gaya hai ke namaz poore tareeqe se qayam karoon. Aur mujhe yeh bhi hukm diya gaya hai ke Allah se daroon: Us ke hukm par chaloon aur Us ki mana ki hui cheezon se bachoon. Wohi yakta hai jo Qayamat ke din bandon ko apne saamne jama karega, taake un ke aamaal ka faisla kare.
73: Wohi hai jis ne aasmaano aur zameen ko ek maqsad ke saath paida kiya. Aur jis din Allah kisi cheez se kahega 'ho ja' aur woh ho jayegi: is se murad Qayamat ka din hai, jab Allah kahega 'utho' aur sab uth khade honge. Us ka kalaam haqq hai jo zaroor poora hoga. Qayamat ke din, jab farishta Israfeel doosri baar soor phoonkega, to saara ikhtiyar sirf Allah ka hoga. Woh chhipi aur khuli har cheez ko jaanta hai. Woh apni takhleeq aur apne intezam mein Hikmat wala hai. Aur Woh chhipi cheez se bhi usi tarah khabardar hai jaise khuli se, aur Us se kuch chhipa nahin.
74: Aey Rasool, woh waqt yaad kijiye jab Ibrahim (alaihis salaam) ne apne baap Aazar se kaha, jo mushrik tha: aey baap, kya aap buton ko maabood banate hain aur Allah ko chhod kar un ki ibadat karte hain? Main samajhta hoon ke aap aur aap ki qaum, jo buton ki ibadat karti hai, haqq ke raaste se khul kar bhatke hue aur uljhan mein hain, kyunke aap Allah ke siwa doosron ki ibadat karte hain. Allah hi yakta hai jo ibadat ka haqdaar hai, aur kisi aur ko ibadat ka koi haqq nahin.
75: Aur jis tarah Maine Ibrahim (alaihis salaam) ko un ke baap aur un ki qaum ki gumraahi dikhayi, usi tarah Maine unhein aasmaano aur zameen ki bari baadshahat bhi dikhayi, taake woh use Allah ke yakta hone aur Usi ke ibadat ke laayak hone ki daleel banayein. Is se unhein yeh yaqeen bhi ho gaya ke Allah yakta hai, Us ka koi sharik nahin, aur Woh har cheez par qudrat rakhta hai.
76: Jab Ibrahim (alaihis salaam) par raat ka andhera chhaa gaya, to woh apni qaum se behas karne lage, taake unhein shirk se tauheed ki taraf laa sakein. Un ki qaum sitaron ki ibadat karti thi, is liye jab unhon ne ek sitara dekha to kaha: 'Yeh mera Rubb hai', is maqsad se ke apni qaum ko qaayal kar sakein. Phir jab woh sitara doob gaya, to unhon ne kaha: 'Main doobne wali cheezon ko pasand nahin karta, kyunke sachcha maabood hamesha maujood rahta hai aur kabhi doobta nahin.' Un ki qaum ka aqeeda yeh tha ke maabood jate aur doobte nahin, is liye unhon ne un hi ka yeh aqeeda un ke khilaaf daleel banaya.
77: Phir jab Ibrahim (alaihis salaam) ne chaand ko nikalte dekha, to apni qaum se kaha: 'Yeh mera Rubb hai', un ke khilaaf apni daleel jari rakhte hue. Phir jab woh doob gaya, to unhon ne kaha: 'Agar Allah ne mujhe apne yakta hone aur apni ibadat ki hidayat na di, to main zaroor un logon mein se ho jaoonga jo Us ke deen se bhatke hue hain aur Us ke siwa doosron ki ibadat karte hain.'
78: Phir jab unhon ne sooraj ko nikalte dekha, to apni qaum se kaha: 'Yeh nikalne wali cheez mera Rubb hai. Yeh sitare aur chaand se bari hai', un ke khilaaf apni daleel aur apna mansooba aur aage barhate hue. Phir jab woh doob gaya, to unhon ne kaha: 'Aey meri qaum, main un sab se bezaar hoon jinhein tum Allah ka sharik thehrate ho.'
79: Maine apna deen us Allah ke liye khaalis kar liya jis ne aasmaano aur zameen ko bina kisi pehli misaal ke paida kiya: main shirk chhod kar khaalis tauheed ki taraf jhuk gaya. Aur main un mushrikon mein se nahin jo Allah ke siwa doosron ki ibadat karte hain.
80: Ibrahim ki qaum ne, jo mushrik thi, un se Allah ke yakta hone ke baare mein jhagda kiya aur unhein apne buton se daraya. Unhon ne un se kaha: kya tum mujh se Allah ke yakta hone aur sirf Usi ki ibadat ke baare mein jhagadte ho, jab ke mere Rubb ne mujhe is ki hidayat di hai? Mujhe tumhare buton ka koi dar nahin, kyunke woh na nuqsan pahuncha sakte hain aur na faida, siwaye is ke ke Allah chahe. Jo Allah chahta hai wahi hota hai. Allah ka ilm har cheez ko ghere hue hai, aur zameen ya aasman ki koi cheez Us se chhipi nahin. Aey qaum, phir kya tum nasihat nahin loge, apna kufr aur Allah ke saath sharik thehrana nahin chhodoge, aur sirf Us par iman nahin laaoge?
81: Aur main un buton se kaise daroon jin ki tum Allah ke siwa ibadat karte ho, jab ke tum khud is se nahin darte ke tum Allah ki paidaa ki hui cheezon ko Us ka sharik thehra rahe ho, aur is ke liye tumhare paas koi daleel bhi nahin? Dono giroh mein se, mowahhid aur mushrik, kaun zyada aman aur chain ka haqdaar hai? Agar tum jaante ho ke kaun sa giroh zyada haqdaar hai, to usi giroh ke peeche chalo. Aur zyada haqdaar be-shak mominon ka woh giroh hai jo tauheed par hai.
82: Jo log Allah par iman laate hain, Us ke ahkaam par chalte hain, aur apne iman ko shirk se nahin milate, wahi log aman aur chain mein honge. Aur yahi woh log hain jinhein un ke Rubb ne hidayat ka raasta dikhaya.
83: Sitare, chaand aur sooraj ke doobne ki woh daleel, jis se Ibrahim (alaihis salaam) ne behas mein apni qaum ko shikast di, Meri hi daleel hai, jo Maine unhein dikhayi aur apni qaum ke khilaaf istemaal karne ke liye di. Main apne bandon mein se jis ko chahoon duniya aur Aakhirat mein darje buland karta hoon. Aey Rasool, aap ka Rubb apni takhleeq aur apne intezam mein Hikmat wala hai, aur Woh apne bandon ko khoob jaanta hai.
84: Aur Maine Ibrahim ko un ke bete Ishaq aur un ke pote Yaqub ki naimat di, aur in sab ko seedhe raaste ki hidayat di. Aur in se pehle Maine Nooh ko haqq ke raaste ki hidayat di; aur Nooh ki aulaad mein se Dawood, un ke bete Sulaiman, Ayub, Yusuf, Moosa aur un ke bhai Haroon (alaihimus salaam) ko hidayat di. Aur jis tarah Maine nabiyon ko ehsan karne ka badla diya, usi tarah Main un tamam logon ko bhi aisa hi badla doonga jo ehsan karte hain, chahe woh nabi na hon.
85: Aur isi tarah Maine Zakariya, Yahya, Isa ibn-e-Maryam aur Ilyas (alaihimus salaam) ko hidayat di. Yeh tamam nabi neik logon mein se the, jinhein Allah ne rasool banane ke liye chun liya.
86: Aur isi tarah Maine Ismail, Al-Yasa, Yunus aur Lut (alaihimus salaam) ko hidayat di. Maine in sab ko nabuwwat se nawaza, aur in sab mein behtareen Muhammad ﷺ hain, jo tamam logon se buland hain.
87: Aur Maine un ke kuch bap-dada, un ki aulaad aur un ke bhaiyon ko bhi hidayat di, jinhein Main hidayat dena chahta tha. Maine unhein chun liya aur unhein seedhe raaste par chalaya: Allah ke yakta hone aur Us ki itaat ke raaste par.
88: Jo hidayat unhein mili woh Allah ki hidayat thi, jo Woh apne bandon mein se jis ko chahe ata karta hai. Aur agar woh Allah ke saath kisi ko sharik thehrate, to un ke aamaal zaaya ho jate, kyunke Allah ke saath sharik thehrana neik aamaal ko mita deta hai.
89: Jin nabiyon ka zikr hua, wahi log hain jinhein Maine kitabein, hikmat aur nabuwwat di. Phir agar aap ki qaum in cheezon mein se kisi ka inkaar kare jo Maine unhein di hain, to Maine doosre log tayyar kar rakhe hain jo kufr nahin karte, balke use maante hain aur mazbooti se thaam lete hain. Yeh Muhajireen aur Ansaar hain, aur woh tamam log jo Qayamat tak bhalai mein un ki pairvi karte hain.
90: Woh nabi aur un ke bap-dada, un ki aulaad aur un ke bhai jin ka zikr hua, wahi sachche hidayat wale log hain, lihaza un ki pairvi kijiye aur un ke naqsh-e-qadam par chaliye. Aey Rasool, apni qaum se keh dijiye: main is Quran ke pahunchane par tum se koi ajr nahin chahta. Quran to tamam jahanon ke insaano aur jinnon ke liye ek nasihat hai, taake woh is ke zariye seedhe raaste ki hidayat paayein.
91: Mushrikon ne Allah ki us tarah qadr nahin ki jaisa Us ki qadr karne ka haqq tha, jab unhon ne apne Nabi Muhammad ﷺ se kaha: 'Allah ne kisi insaan par koi wahi nahin utari.' Aey Rasool, in se keh dijiye: phir kaun hai jis ne Moosa (alaihis salaam) par Taurat utari, jo un ki qaum ke liye noor aur hidayat thi? Yahudiyon ne use alag alag warqon mein kar diya; jo un ki khwahish ke mutabiq hai woh dikhate hain aur jo mutabiq nahin woh chhipate hain, jaise Muhammad ﷺ ki sifat. Aur aey Arabo, tumhein Quran sikhaya gaya, jise na tum jaante the aur na tumhare bade-buzurg. Aey Rasool, in se keh dijiye: 'Allah ne hi use utara,' phir unhein un ki na-waaqfiyat aur un ki gumraahi mein chhod dijiye, jab tak un ke paas sab se yaqeeni cheez, yani maut, na aa jaye.
92: Aur aey Nabi, yeh Quran ek aisi kitab hai jo Maine aap par utari. Yeh barkat wali kitab hai jo apne se pehle utari hui aasmani kitabon ki tasdeeq karti hai, aur aap par is liye utari gayi ke aap Makkah walon ko aur poorab aur pachham ke tamam logon ko daraayein, taake woh seedhe raaste par aa jayein. Jo log Aakhirat ki zindagi par iman rakhte hain, woh is Quran ko maante hain, us par amal karte hain, aur apni namaz ki hifazat karte hain: us ke taqaze, us ke arkaan aur us ki sunnatein shariat ke muqarrar waqton par poore karte hain.
93: Sab se bada zaalim woh shaks hai jo Allah par jhoot ghadta hai aur kehta hai: 'Allah ne kisi insaan par kuch nahin utara'; ya jhoot kehta hai: 'Mujh par Allah ne wahi bheji hai', halanke Allah ne us par koi wahi nahin bheji; ya kehta hai: 'Main bhi us Quran jaisa utaar sakta hoon jo Allah ne utara.' Aey Rasool, aap ek bhayanak manzar dekhte agar aap in zaalimon ko maut ke waqt dekh paate; aur jab farishte unhein azaab dene aur maarne ke liye apne haath barhayenge, aur unhein daantte hue kahenge: apni jaanein nikaalo, kyunke hum unhein lene aaye hain. Aaj tumhein aisi saza di jayegi jo tumhein zaleel aur ruswa karegi, un jhooton ki wajah se jo tum Allah par bolte the: nabuwwat ka daawa, wahi ka daawa, ya yeh daawa ke tum bhi waisa utaar sakte ho jaisa Allah ne utara; aur is wajah se bhi ke tum gurur mein aa kar Us ki nishaniyan maanne se inkaar karte the.
94: Qayamat ke din un se kaha jayega: aaj tum Hamare paas akele akele aaye ho. Ab tumhare paas na koi maal hai aur na koi sardaari, aur tum Mere paas usi tarah aaye ho jaise Maine tumhein pehli baar paida kiya tha: nange paon, nange badan aur bina khatna ke. Jo kuch Maine tumhein duniya mein diya tha, use tum na-chaahte hue peeche chhod aaye ho. Aaj Main tumhare saath tumhare woh but nahin dekh raha jin ke baare mein tum kehte the ke woh tumhari sifarish karenge aur yeh ke woh ibadat ke haqdaar hone mein Allah ke sharik hain. Tumhare aur un ke darmiyan sab taalluq kat gaye. Un ki sifarish ka aur un ke Allah ka sharik hone ka tumhara daawa tum se gaayab ho gaya.
95: Allah hi yakta hai jo daane ko phaadta hai, jis se kheti nikalti hai, aur khajoor ki gutli ko, jis se khajoor ka darakht ugta hai. Woh zinda ko murda se nikaalta hai, jaise insaan aur baaqi tamam jaanwar nutfe se bante hain; aur murda ko zinda se nikaalta hai, jaise insaan se nutfa nikalta hai aur murgi anda deti hai. Yeh sab karne wali hasti Allah hai, jis ne tumhein paida kiya. Aey mushriko, phir tum haqq se kaise bhatkaye jate ho, jab ke tum Us ki yeh anokhi takhleeq apni aankhon se dekhte ho?
96: Wohi, paak hai Woh, subah ki roshni ko raat ke andhere se phaadta hai. Wohi hai jis ne raat ko sukoon ka waqt banaya, jis mein log din ki thakaan aur mehnat se aaram paate hain. Aur Wohi hai jis ne sooraj aur chaand ko ek theek andaze ke mutabiq chalaya. Yeh anokhi takhleeq us Ghalib ka muqarrar kiya hua nizam hai, jis par koi ghalib nahin aa sakta, aur jo jaanta hai ke Us ki makhlooq ki bhalai kis mein hai.
97: Aey Adam (alaihis salaam) ki aulaad, Wohi, paak hai Woh, hai jis ne tumhare liye aasman mein sitare banaye, taake jab khushki aur samundar ke raaste tum par wazeh na hon to tum safar mein un se raasta paao. Maine un logon ke liye apni qudrat ki dalilein aur nishaniyan khol kar bayan kar di hain jo gaur karte hain aur un se faida uthate hain.
98: Wohi, paak hai Woh, hai jis ne tumhein ek jaan se paida kiya, jo tumhare baap Adam (alaihis salaam) ki jaan thi. Us ne tumhari takhleeq ka aaghaz is tarah kiya ke tumhare baap Adam ko mitti se banaya, phir un se tumhein paida kiya. Aur Us ne tumhare liye ek thehrne ki jagah bhi banayi, yani tumhari maaon ke pet, aur ek rakhne ki jagah jis mein tum rakhe jate ho, yani tumhare baapon ki pushtein. Maine un logon ke liye nishaniyan khol kar bayan kar di hain jo Allah ki baat samajh sakte hain.
99: Wohi, paak hai Woh, hai jis ne aasman se baarish ka paani utara, phir us se har tarah ki ugne wali cheezein ugayin. Un se Us ne kheti aur hare darakht nikale, jin se Woh aisa daana paida karta hai jo ek doosre par tah-ba-tah hota hai, jaise bali mein hota hai. Aur khajoor ke gabhe se aise guchhe nikalte hain jo khade ya bethe hue har shaks ke qareeb hote hain. Us ne angoor ke baagh bhi nikale; aur zaitoon aur anaar bhi paida karta hai, jin ke patte ek jaise hote hain magar phal alag alag. Aey logo, un phalon ko dekho jab woh pehli baar nikalte hain aur jab woh pakte hain. Aey logo, is mein un logon ke liye Allah ki qudrat ki khuli dalilein hain jo Allah par iman rakhte hain. Yahi log hain jo in dalilon se faida uthayenge.
100: Phir bhi mushrikon ne jinnon ko ibadat mein Allah ka sharik bana liya, yeh samajh kar ke jinn apne taur par faida pahuncha sakte hain aur nuqsan de sakte hain, halanke Allah hi ne unhein paida kiya, is liye Wohi ibadat ka sab se zyada haqdaar hai. Aur apni na-waaqfiyat mein unhon ne Allah ke liye bete bhi thehra diye, jaise Yahudiyon ne Uzair ke baare mein aur Nasara ne Isa (alaihis salaam) ke baare mein kiya, aur betiyan bhi. Allah us sab se paak aur buland hai jo baatil wale Us ke baare mein kehte hain.
101: Wohi, paak hai Woh, aasmaano aur zameen ko bina kisi pehli misaal ke banane wala hai. Us ki aulaad kaise ho sakti hai jab Us ki koi biwi hi nahin? Us ne har cheez paida ki aur Woh har cheez jaanta hai. Us se kuch chhipa nahin.
102: Aey logo, jis hasti mein yeh sifaat hain, wahi tumhara Rubb hai. Us ke siwa tumhara koi Rubb nahin, aur Us ke siwa koi ibadat ke laayak nahin. Wohi har cheez ka Khaaliq hai, lihaza sirf Usi ki ibadat karo, kyunke Wohi yakta ibadat ka haqdaar hai. Aur Wohi har cheez ki dekh-bhaal karta hai.
103: Nigahein Us ka ihata nahin kar sakteen, magar Us ki nigah har cheez ko ghere aur apne ihate mein liye hue hai. Wohi hai jo apne neik bandon par bareek-been meharbani karne wala aur un se khoob khabar rakhne wala hai.
104: Aey logo, tumhare Rubb ki taraf se tumhare paas khuli dalilein aa chuki hain. Jo unhein samjhe aur un se nasihat le, us ka faida usi ko lautega. Aur jo un se andha rahe aur gaafil rahe, us ka nuqsan bhi usi ka hai. Aur meri zimmedaari nahin ke main tum par nigraani karoon aur tumhare aamaal likhoon: main to sirf apne Rubb ka bheja hua rasool hoon. Wohi hai jo tum par nigraani rakhta hai.
105: Aur jis tarah Maine apni qudrat ki tarah tarah ki dalilein khol kar bayan kein, usi tarah Main tarah tarah ki woh aayatein bhi khol kar bayan karta hoon jin mein wade, tambeeh aur nasihat hai. Is par mushrik kahenge: yeh wahi nahin: yeh to woh baatein hain jo aap ne apne se pehle ahl-e-kitab se seekh li hain. Aur Maine aisa is liye kiya ke Muhammad ﷺ ki ummat ke mominon par haqq wazeh kar doon, kyunke wahi log hain jo haqq qabool karte hain aur us ki pairvi karte hain.
106: Aey Rasool, us haqq ki pairvi kijiye jo aap ke Rubb ki taraf se aap par wahi kiya jata hai. Us ke siwa koi ibadat ke laayak nahin, paak hai Woh. Aur apne dil ko kafiron aur un ki hath-dharmi ki fikr mein na daaliye, kyunke un ka maamla Allah ke hawale hai.
107: Agar Allah chahta ke woh Us ke saath kisi ko sharik na thehrayein, to woh aisa na karte. Aey Rasool, Maine aap ko un ke aamaal likhne wala nigehban nahin banaya, aur na aap un ke zimmedaar hain. Aap to sirf Rasool hain aur aap ki zimmedaari sirf paigham pahunchana hai.
108: Aey momino, un buton ko bura-bhala na kaho jin ki woh Allah ke saath ibadat karte hain, chahe woh is ke haqdaar hi kyun na hon, kyunke phir mushrik apni na-waaqfiyat mein, bina jaane, Allah ko bura-bhala kahenge, paak hai Woh. Aur jis tarah Us ne un ki gumraahi unhein khoobsurat kar dikhayi, usi tarah Woh har qaum ka chalan, achha ho ya bura, unhein khoobsurat kar dikhata hai, aur woh usi par amal karte hain. Phir Qayamat ke din un ka lautna apne Rubb hi ki taraf hai, jo unhein bata dega ke woh duniya mein kya karte the, aur un ke aamaal ka badla dega.
109: Mushrik Allah ki apni sab se pakki qasmein kha kar kehte hain ke agar Muhammad ﷺ un ke maange hue nishanon mein se koi nishani le aayein, to woh iman le aayenge. Aey Rasool, in se keh dijiye: nishaniyan mere paas nahin ke main unhein laaoon: woh sirf Allah ke paas hain, jo unhein apni marzi se utarta hai. Aur aey mominon, tumhein kya khabar ke agar yeh nishaniyan un ke mutalbe ke mutabiq aa bhi jayein, to bhi woh iman nahin laayenge? Balke woh apne jhutlane aur apni hath-dharmi par jame rahenge, kyunke haqeeqat mein woh hidayat chahte hi nahin.
110: Aur Main un ke dil aur un ki nigahein pher doonga, un ke aur haqq ki hidayat ke darmiyan aad ban kar, jaise Main pehli baar un ki hath-dharmi ki wajah se un ke aur Quran par iman ke darmiyan aad bana tha. Main unhein un ki gumraahi aur apne Rubb ke khilaaf un ki sarkashi mein chhod doonga, uljhe aur bhatakte hue.
111: Aur agar Main un ka mutalba maan leta aur woh sab laa deta jo unhon ne maanga, ke farishte un ke saamne utaar deta, aur murdon ko un se baat karwata ke aap ki laayi hui baat sachchi hai, aur har cheez un ki aankhon ke saamne jama kar deta, to bhi woh aap ki laayi hui baat par iman na laate, siwaye is ke ke Allah un ki hidayat chahta. Magar un mein se aksar is baat se na-waaqif hain aur Allah ki taraf rujoo nahin karte ke Woh unhein hidayat de.
112: Aey Rasool, jis tarah Maine aap ko in mushrikon ki aap se dushmani se aazmaya, usi tarah Maine aap se pehle har nabi ko aazmaya. Maine un mein se har ek ke liye sarkash insaano aur jinnon mein se dushman bana diye, jo ek doosre ke dilon mein buri baatein daalte the aur baatil ko khoobsurat bana kar unhein dhoka dete the. Agar Main chahta ke woh aisa na karein, to woh aisa na karte; magar Maine yeh un ki aazmaish ke liye chaaha. Lihaza unhein un ke kufr aur baatil ke ghade hue jhoot par chhod dijiye, aur un par koi dhyaan na dijiye.
113: Yeh is liye hai ke jo log Aakhirat ko nahin maante, un ke dil us baat ki taraf jhuk jayein jo woh ek doosre ke kaan mein daalte hain, aur woh use apne liye khushi se qabool kar lein, aur un gunahon aur buraiyon par jame rahein jo woh kar rahe the.
114: Aey Rasool, un mushrikon se keh dijiye jo Allah ke saath doosron ki ibadat karte hain: kya yeh baat samajh mein aati hai ke main apne aur tumhare darmiyan Allah ke siwa kisi aur ko faisla karne wala maanoon, jab ke Allah hi ne woh Quran utara hai jo har cheez ko kaafi tafseel se khol deta hai? Aur Yahudi, jinhein Maine Taurat di, aur Nasara, jinhein Maine Injeel di, yeh jaante hain ke Quran aap par utara gaya, kyunke is ki daleel un ki apni kitabon mein maujood hai. Lihaza un logon mein se na hon jo us ke baare mein shak karte hain jo Maine aap par utara.
115: Aap ke Rubb ka kalaam, yani Quran, apni khabron ki sachhaai aur apne ahkaam aur apni mumaniat ke insaaf mein mukammal hai. Us ke kalaam ko koi badal nahin sakta. Wohi hai jo apne bandon ki baatein sunta aur jaanta hai. Us se kuch chhipa nahin aur Woh un ke aamaal ka badla dega.
116: Aey Rasool, agar aap zameen ke aksar logon ke peeche chalein, to woh aap ko Allah ke deen se bhatka denge. Allah ka dastoor hamesha yahi raha hai ke haqq thodon ke saath hota hai. Aksar log sirf un atkal ke peeche chalte hain jis ki koi buniyaad nahin, aur woh samajhte hain ke jin ki woh ibadat karte hain woh unhein Allah ke qareeb kar denge, halanke yeh maan kar woh bilkul galti par hain.
117: Aey Rasool, aap ka Rubb un logon ko khoob jaanta hai jo Us ke raaste se bhatke hue hain; aur Wohi un ko bhi khoob jaanta hai jo us par seedhi hidayat par hain. Is mein se kuch Us se chhipa nahin.
118: Aey logo, us jaanwar mein se khao jise Allah ka naam le kar zibah kiya gaya, agar tum waqai Us ki khuli dalilein maante ho.
119: Aey momino, tumhein kis cheez ne roka hai ke tum us jaanwar ka gosht khao jo Allah ke naam par zibah kiya gaya, jab ke Allah ne tum par haraam cheezein khol kar bata di hain? Lihaza tumhare liye zaroori hai ke haraam cheezein chhod do, siwaye is ke ke tum majboori mein unhein khane par aa jao, us soorat mein woh halal hain. Aur bahut se gumraah mushrik apne pairokaaron ko apni galat raayon se bhatkate hain. Woh us cheez ko halal thehrate hain jo Allah ne haraam ki, jaise murdar; aur us cheez ko haraam thehrate hain jo Allah ne halal ki, jaise bahira, wasila aur haami waghairah. Aey Rasool, aap ka Rubb un logon ko khoob jaanta hai jo Us ki hadein phaand jate hain, aur Woh unhein un ki is zyadati ka badla dega.
120: Aey logo, gunah karne se bacho, chahe khule-aam ho ya chhup kar. Jo log gunah karte hain, chhupe ho ya khule, Allah unhein un ke kiye ka badla dega.
121: Aey musalmano, us jaanwar ka gosht na khao jise Allah ke naam par zibah nahin kiya gaya, chahe us par Allah ke siwa kisi aur ka naam liya gaya ho ya nahin. Aisa haraam khana Allah ki itaat chhod kar nafarmani apnana hai. Aur shaytan apne doston ke dil mein baatein daalte hain aur unhein shak mein daalte hain, taake woh tum se murdar khane ke baare mein jhagda karein. Aey musalmano, agar tum un shubhon mein un ke peeche chal pado jo woh murdar ke halal hone ke liye pesh karte hain, to tum Allah ke saath sharik thehrane mein un ke barabar ho jaoge.
122: Kya woh shaks, jo Allah ki hidayat milne se pehle apne kufr, apni na-waaqfiyat aur apne gunahon ki wajah se murda tha, phir Us ne use iman, ilm aur itaat ki hidayat de kar zinda kar diya, us shaks ke barabar hai jo kufr, na-waaqfiyat aur gunahon ke andheron se nikal nahin sakta, aur jis ke liye raaste na-saaf aur andhere ho gaye? Aur jis tarah in mushrikon ke liye shirk, murdar khana aur jhooti behas khoobsurat bana di gayi, usi tarah kafiron ke gunah bhi unhein achhe kar dikhaye gaye, taake unhein Qayamat ke din un ka dardnaak azaab diya jaye.
123: Aur jis tarah Makkah ke un sardaron ke saath hua jinhon ne shirk kiya aur doosron ko Allah ke raaste se roka, usi tarah Us ne har basti mein aise sardar aur asar wale log rakhe hain jo tarah tarah ke tareeqon aur chaalon se shaytan ke raaste ki taraf bulate hain aur rasoolon aur un ke pairokaaron ki mukhalifat karte hain. Haqeeqat mein un ki chaalein aur un ke mansoobe aakhir mein unhein hi nuqsan denge, magar apni na-waaqfiyat aur apni khwahishon ki pairvi ki wajah se woh yeh nahin samajhte.
124: Aur jab in sardaron mein se kisi ke paas koi aayat ya nishani aati hai jo Allah apne Nabi par utarta hai aur jo un ki sachhaai saabit karti hai, to woh kehte hain: hum ise kabhi nahin maanenge jab tak Allah humein bhi nabuwwat na de, jaise us ne pehle nabiyon ko di. Allah un ki baat rad karte hue farmata hai ke Wohi behtar jaanta hai ke is zimmedaari ke liye kaun sab se munasib hai, aur Woh nabuwwat aur risalat ke liye sirf behtareen logon ko chunta hai. In hadein phaandne walon ko haqq ke muqable mein apne gurur ki wajah se zillat aur ruswai milegi, aur apni chaalon ki wajah se sakht azaab.
125: Allah jis ko seedhe raaste ki hidayat dena chahta hai, us ka seena Islam ke liye khol deta hai, is liye woh use khushi se qabool kar leta hai. Aur jise Woh chhod dena aur hidayat na dena chahta hai, us ka seena itna tang kar deta hai ke woh haqq qabool nahin kar sakta, yahan tak ke woh us shaks jaisa ho jata hai jo fiza ki buland tah mein chadh raha ho aur use saans lena mushkil se mushkil-tar hota ja raha ho. Aur jis tarah Allah ne yeh shadeed tangi gumraah shaks ka haal banaya, usi tarah Woh un logon par azaab daalega jo Us par iman nahin rakhte.
126: Aey Rasool, yeh deen jo Maine aap ko diya hai, Mera seedha raasta hai, jis mein koi tedhapan nahin. Maine us shaks ke liye aayatein khol kar bayan kar di hain jo samajh rakhta hai.
127: Aise logon ko Qayamat ke din Jannat di jayegi, jis mein woh har tarah ke nuqsan aur takleef se mehfooz honge. Allah un ka dost, un ka kaar-saaz, un ka madadgaar aur un ka nigehban hoga. Yeh un neik aamaal ka badla hoga jo woh karte the.
128: Aey Rasool, woh din yaad kijiye jab Allah jinnon aur insaano dono ko jama karega. Woh jinnon se khitaab karega aur unhein batayega ke unhon ne bahut se logon ko gumraah kiya aur unhein Allah ke raaste se roka. Insaano mein se un ke pairokaar apne Rubb ko jawab dete hue kahenge: aey hamare Rubb, hum ne ek doosre se faida uthaya: jinnon ne is tarah ke insaan un ke peeche chale; aur insaano ne is tarah ke jinnon ke zariye apni khwahishein poori kein. Aur ab hum us waqt tak pahunch gaye jo tu ne hamare liye muqarrar kiya tha, aur yeh Qayamat ka din hai. Allah unhein batayega ke Jahannam ki aag un ka ghar hogi, jahan woh hamesha rahenge, siwaye un gunahgaar mowahhidon ke jinhein Allah us se nikaalna chahega. Aey Rasool, aap ka Rubb apne mansoobe aur apne intezam mein Hikmat wala hai; Woh jaanta hai ke Us ke bandon mein se azaab ka haqdaar kaun hai.
129: Aur jis tarah Maine kuch sarkash jinnon ko kuch logon ko bhatkane ki taaqat di, usi tarah Main har bure gunahgaar ko doosre gunahgaron par ek zor aur asar doonga, taake woh unhein burai par ubhaarein, un ke dilon mein bhalai se nafrat daalein aur unhein us se pher dein. Yeh un gunahon ka poora insaaf wala badla hai jo woh karte the.
130: Qayamat ke din Main jinnon aur insaano se khitaab karoonga aur un se poochoonga ke kya un ke paas un hi ki jins mein se rasool nahin aaye the, jo unhein Allah ki utari hui baat padh kar sunate the aur unhein is din se daraate the ke woh is se milenge, yani Qayamat ke din se? Woh kahenge: kyun nahin, zaroor aaye. Aaj hum apne khilaaf iqrar karte hain ke tere rasoolon ne tera paigham hum tak pahuncha diya tha, aur hum is din se milne ka bhi iqrar karte hain; magar hum ne tere rasoolon ko jhutlaya aur is din se milne ka inkaar kiya. Duniya ki zindagi ne apni waqti raunaq, apni sajawat aur apne aish ke saath unhein dhoke mein daal diya tha, aur woh apne khilaaf iqrar karenge ke unhon ne duniya mein Allah aur Us ke rasoolon ka inkaar kiya. Magar yeh iqrar aur yeh maan lena unhein koi faida nahin dega, kyunke us ke faida dene ka waqt guzar chuka hoga.
131: Insaano aur jinnon ki taraf rasool bhejne ki wajah yeh hai ke kisi ko us ke jurm par azaab na diya jaye jab tak us ki taraf koi rasool bhej kar use daraa na diya gaya ho aur daawat us tak pahunch na gayi ho. Maine kisi qaum ko azaab sirf us ke baad diya ke un ki taraf rasool bhej diye.
132: Un mein se har ek ke apne aamaal ke mutabiq darje honge. Jis ne bahut burai ki, woh us ke barabar nahin jis ne kam ki. Aur pairokaar un ke barabar nahin jin ki pairvi ki gayi. Isi tarah neki karne walon ka badla bhi ek jaisa nahin hoga. Aur aap ka Rubb un ke aamaal se be-khabar nahin. Balke Woh un se khoob waaqif hai. Un mein se kuch Us se chhipa nahin aur Woh unhein un ke aamaal ka badla dega.
133: Aey Rasool, aap ka Rubb apne bandon se be-niyaz hai. Woh na un ka mohtaaj hai aur na un ki ibadat ka. Un ka kufr Us ka kuch nahin bigaadta. Aur un se be-niyaz hone ke baawajood Woh un par Meharban hai. Aey nafarmani karne walo, agar Woh tumhein mitana chahe to apne azaab se tumhein mita de, aur phir tumhare baad doosre log le aaye jo Us par iman laayein aur Us ki itaat karein, jaise Us ne tumhein un logon ki nasl se paida kiya jo tum se pehle guzre.
134: Aey kafiro, jis dobara zinda hone, uthne, hisaab aur azaab ka tum se wada kiya gaya hai, woh zaroor hoga. Aur tum bhaag kar apne Rubb se bach nahin sakoge: Woh tumhein pakdega aur azaab dega.
135: Aey Rasool, keh dijiye: aey meri qaum, agar tum chaho to apne kufr aur apni gumraahi ke raaste par jame raho, kyunke main apni zimmedaari poori kar chuka aur tum tak paigham pahuncha kar tum par hujjat qayam kar chuka hoon. Lihaza ab mujhe tumhare kufr aur tumhari gumraahi ki fikr nahin. Main to us haqq ke raaste par jama rahoonga jis par main hoon. Tum jald jaan loge ke duniya mein kaun ghalib aayega aur zameen ka waris banega, aur kaun Aakhirat ka ghar paayega. Mushrik kaamyab nahin honge, na duniya mein aur na Aakhirat mein. Un ka anjaam ghaata hi hoga, chahe duniya mein unhein kuch maza mil jaye.
136: Mushrikon ne apne deen mein Allah ke baare mein nayi baatein aur jhoote daawe ghade: unhon ne us kheti aur un chaupayon mein se, jo Us ne paida kiye, ek hissa Us ke liye muqarrar kiya aur ek hissa apne buton ke liye. Magar jo hissa unhon ne apne thehraye hue sharikon ko diya, woh un raaston tak nahin pahunchta jin mein kharch karne ka Allah ne hukm diya, jaise gareebon aur mohtaajon par. Aur jo hissa unhon ne Allah ke liye rakha, woh buton tak pahunch jata hai aur un par kharch hota hai. Un ka faisla aur un ki taqseem kitni buri hai!
137: Aur jis tarah shaytan ne mushrikon ke liye yeh na-insaaf faisla khoobsurat bana diya, usi tarah un ke un sharikon aur saathiyon, yani shaytanon, ne unhein yeh baat bhi achhi kar dikhayi ke woh tangi ke dar se apni aulaad ko qatl kar dein. Shaytanon ne un ke dil mein yeh baat is liye daali ke unhein us qatl ke zariye halak kar dein jise Allah ne haraam kiya tha, aur un par un ka deen itna uljha dein ke unhein maaloom hi na rahe ke Allah ne un ke liye kya hukm diya aur kya mana kiya. Aur agar Allah chahta ke woh aisa na karein, to woh aisa na karte. Magar Us ne apni hikmat se yahi chaaha. Lihaza aey Rasool, in mushrikon ko aur Allah ke baare mein un ke ghade hue jhooton ko chhod dijiye, kyunke yeh aap ka kuch nahin bigaadega, aur un ka maamla Allah ke hawale kar dijiye.
138: Mushrikon ne kaha ke kuch jaanwar aur kuch kheti rok li gayi hai, aur un mein se sirf wahi kha sakte hain jinhein woh chahein, jaise buton ke pujari aur kuch doosre log: yeh un ka apna daawa aur apni ghadi hui baat thi. Unhon ne yeh bhi kaha ke kuch jaanwaron ki peethein haraam hain aur un par koi sawaar nahin ho sakta aur na un par bojh laada ja sakta hai. Phir unhon ne yeh daawa kiya ke kuch jaanwaron par zibah ke waqt Allah ka naam nahin liya jana chahiye, balke un ki jagah buton ke naam liye jayein. Yeh sab unhon ne jhoot ke saath Allah ki taraf mansoob kiya. Allah unhein apne azaab ka badla dega, un baaton par jo unhon ne Us ke baare mein ghadin.
139: Unhon ne kaha: in roke hue jaanwaron ke peton ka bachcha, agar zinda paida ho, to hamare mardon ke liye halal hai aur hamari auraton par haraam. Aur agar woh mara hua paida ho, to mard aur aurat dono us mein shareek honge. Allah unhein is baat ka poora insaaf wala badla dega. Woh apni shariat mein aur apni makhlooq ke kaam chalane mein Hikmat wala hai, aur unhein khoob jaanta hai.
140: Jin logon ne apni nadani aur na-waaqfiyat mein apni aulaad ko qatl kiya, aur un jaanwaron ko haraam thehraya jo Allah ne unhein rozi mein diye, aur yeh jhoot ke saath Allah ki taraf mansoob kiya, woh barbaad ho gaye. Woh seedhe raaste se bhatak gaye aur us ki hidayat na paa sake.
141: Allah, paak hai Woh, Wohi hai jis ne aise baagh paida kiye jo tanon aur chhappron par zameen se uthaye jate hain, aur aise baagh bhi jo zameen par bina tanon ke phaile hue hain. Wohi hai jis ne khajoor ka darakht paida kiya. Aur Us ne aisi kheti nikali jis ki shakal aur jis ka zaiqa alag alag hai. Wohi hai jis ne zaitoon aur anaar paida kiye, jin ke patte ek jaise hain magar phal alag alag. Aey logo, jab woh phal laaye to us mein se khao, aur us ki kataai ke din us ki zakaat ada karo. Aur khane aur kharch karne mein shariat ki hadein na phaando, kyunke Allah un logon se mohabbat nahin karta jo is mein aur doosri baaton mein Us ki hadein phaandte hain; balke Woh aise logon ko na-pasand karta hai. Jis ne yeh sab paida kiya, Usi ne ise apne bandon ke liye halal kiya. Lihaza mushrikon ko koi haqq nahin ke ise haraam thehrayein.
142: Aur Wohi hai jis ne tumhare liye kuch aise jaanwar paida kiye jo bojh uthane ke laayak hain, jaise bade oont, aur kuch aise jo is kaam ke laayak nahin, jaise chhote oont, bakriyan aur bhedein. Aey logo, un halal cheezon mein se khao jo Allah ne tumhein rozi mein di hain, aur shaytan ke naqsh-e-qadam par na chalo ke us cheez ko halal thehrao jo Allah ne haraam ki aur us cheez ko haraam thehrao jo Allah ne halal ki, jaise mushrik karte hain. Aey logo, shaytan tumhara khula dushman hai, kyunke woh chahta hai ke tum aisa karke Allah ki mukhalifat karo.
143: Us ne tumhare liye aath qism ke jaanwar paida kiye: bhed ke do, nar aur maada, aur bakri ke do. Aey Rasool, mushrikon se poochiye: kya Allah ne dono naron ko sirf is liye haraam kiya ke woh nar hain? Agar woh kahein 'haan', to un se poochiye: phir tum maadaon ko kyun haraam samjhte ho? Ya kya Us ne dono maadaon ko sirf is liye haraam kiya ke woh maada hain? Agar woh kahein 'haan', to un se poochiye: phir tum naron ko kyun haraam samjhte ho? Ya kya Us ne us ko haraam kiya jo dono maadaon ke pet mein hai, sirf is liye ke woh pet mein hai? Agar woh kahein 'haan', to un se poochiye: phir tum pet ke bachchon mein farq kyun karte ho, ke kabhi nar ko haraam thehrate ho aur kabhi maada ko? Aey mushriko, mujhe batao, tum yeh baat kis theek ilm par kehte ho, agar tum is daawe mein sachche ho ke yeh hurmat Allah ki taraf se hai?
144: Aur baaqi aath mein se do oont hain aur do gaay. Aey Rasool, mushrikon se poochiye: kya Allah ne in mein se kisi ko is liye haraam kiya ke woh nar ya maada hai, ya is liye ke woh pet mein tha? Aey mushriko, kya tum us waqt maujood the jab Allah ne un jaanwaron ki hurmat ka hukm diya jinhein tum apne daawe ke mutabiq haraam samjhte ho? Us shaks se bada zaalim aur bada mujrim koi nahin jo Allah par jhoot ghade, aur us cheez ki hurmat Us ki taraf mansoob kare jo Us ne haraam nahin ki, taake logon ko bina kisi buniyaad ke seedhe raaste se bhatka de. Aur Allah un zaalimon ko seedhe raaste ki hidayat nahin deta jo Allah par jhoot ghadte hain.
145: Aey Rasool, keh dijiye: jo wahi Allah ne mujh par ki hai, us mein main kisi cheez ko haraam nahin paata siwaye us ke jo theek tareeqe se zibah kiye baghair mar jaye, aur behta hua khoon, aur suar ka gosht, kyunke woh napaak aur haraam hai, aur woh jo Allah ke siwa kisi aur ke naam par zibah kiya gaya ho, jaise buton ke naam par zibah kiye hue jaanwar. Phir jo shaks shiddat ki bhook se majboor ho kar in haraam cheezon mein se kuch kha le, bina is ke ke us mein maza le aur bina zaroorat ki hadd se aage barhe, us par is mein koi gunah nahin. Aey Rasool, aap ka Rubb us shaks ke liye Bakhshne wala aur Meharban hai jo is ke khane par majboor ho jaye.
146: Aur Maine Yahudiyon par woh jaanwar haraam kiye jin ke punje alag na hon, jaise oont aur shutur-murg. Aur Maine un par gaay aur bakri ki charbi bhi haraam ki, siwaye us ke jo un ki peethon se lagi ho ya un ki aanton par ho ya haddi se mili hui ho, jaise sureen aur pehlu ki charbi. Maine unhein un ki nafarmani ka badla yeh de kar diya ke yeh cheezein un par haraam kar dein. Aur Main jo kuch bayan karta hoon us mein sachcha hoon.
147: Aey Rasool, agar woh aap ko jhutlayein aur us baat ko na maanein jo aap apne Rubb ki taraf se laaye, to unhein targheeb dete hue keh dijiye: tumhara Rubb ek hai, bari rehmat wala. Us ki rehmat hi se Us ne tumhein mohlat di hai aur abhi tak tumhein azaab de kar nahin pakda. Aur unhein daraate hue yeh bhi keh dijiye: Us ka azaab un logon se nahin tala jata jo gunah karte hain.
148: Mushrik Allah ki marzi aur Us ke faisle ko apne shirk ki daleel banate hue kahenge: agar Allah chahta ke na hum Us ke saath kisi ko sharik thehrayein aur na hamare bade-buzurg, to hum aisa na karte; aur agar Woh chahta ke hum apne oopar koi cheez haraam na thehrayein, to hum aisa na karte. In se pehle logon ne bhi apne rasoolon ko aisi hi be-kaar dalilon se jhutlaya tha aur kaha tha: agar Allah chahta ke hum inhein haraam na thehrayein, to hum aisa na karte. Chunanche woh apne jhutlane par jame rahe yahan tak ke unhon ne Mera woh azaab chakh liya jo Maine un par utara. Aey Rasool, in mushrikon se keh dijiye: kya tumhare paas koi daleel hai jo batati ho ke Allah is se raazi hai ke tum Us ke saath doosron ko sharik thehrao, aur us cheez ko halal thehrao jo Us ne haraam ki, aur us cheez ko haraam thehrao jo Us ne halal ki? Sirf tumhara yeh kaam kar lena is baat ka suboot nahin ke Woh is se raazi hai. Tum is maamle mein sirf atkal ke peeche chal rahe ho, aur atkal haqq ke muqable mein koi wazan nahin rakhti. Tum to bas jhoot bol rahe ho.
149: Aey Rasool, mushrikon se keh dijiye: agar tumhare paas sirf yahi kamzor dalilein hain, to Allah ke paas aisi faisla-kun daleel hai jis ke muqable mein tumhare pesh kiye hue uzr koi wazan nahin rakhte aur jis ke saamne woh shubhe gaayab ho jate hain jinhein tum ne thaam rakha hai. Aey mushriko, agar Allah chahta ke tum sab ko haqq ki hidayat de, to Woh aisa kar deta.
150: Aey Rasool, un mushrikon se keh dijiye jo us cheez ko haraam thehrate hain jo Allah ne halal ki, aur daawa karte hain ke Allah hi ne use haraam kiya: apne gawah laao jo yeh gawahi dein ke Allah ne yeh cheezein haraam ki hain. Phir agar woh bina kisi ilm ke gawahi dein ke Allah ne yeh cheezein haraam ki hain, to aey Rasool, un ki gawahi na maaniye, kyunke woh jhooti gawahi hai. Aur un logon ki khwahishon ke peeche na chaliye jinhein un ki khwahishon ne apne qaaboo mein le rakha hai. Unhon ne Us ki aayaton ko jhutlaya jab unhon ne us cheez ko haraam thehraya jo Allah ne halal ki thi. Aur un logon ke peeche na chaliye jo Aakhirat par iman nahin rakhte aur apne Rubb ke saath doosron ko sharik thehrate hain. Jo shaks apne Rubb ke saath aisa sulook karta ho, us ki pairvi kaise ki ja sakti hai?
151: Aey Rasool, logon se keh dijiye: aao! Main tumhein padh kar sunaata hoon ke Allah ne kya haraam kiya hai. Us ne haraam kiya hai ke tum Us ki kisi makhlooq ko Us ka sharik thehrao; ke tum apne maa-baap ki nafarmani karo, kyunke tumhara farz hai ke un ke saath achha sulook karo; ke tum tangi ke dar se apni aulaad ko qatl karo, jaise zamana-e-jahiliyat ke log karte the: Main tumhein bhi rozi deta hoon aur unhein bhi. Aur Us ne yeh bhi haraam kiya hai ke tum be-haayi ke kaamon ke qareeb jao, chahe woh khule-aam hon ya chhupe; aur yeh ke tum us jaan ko qatl karo jise Allah ne haraam kiya hai, siwaye is ke ke woh haqq ke saath ho, jaise zina aur irtidaad ki soorat mein. Us ne tumhein yeh baatein is liye batayi hain ke tum Allah ke hukm aur Us ki mumaniat samjho.
152: Aur Us ne tumhein is se roka hai ke tum yateemon ke maal ke qareeb jao, yani un ke maal ke jin ke baap baaligh hone se pehle mar gaye, jab tak woh baaligh na ho jayein aur unhein samajhdaar na maan liya jaye, siwaye is ke ke tum aise tareeqe se karo jis se us maal ko faida aur izafa ho. Aur Us ne tumhein is se bhi roka hai ke naap ya tol mein kami karo; balke zaroori hai ke khareed-o-farokht mein lete aur dete waqt tum poore aur insaaf wale raho. Woh kisi jaan par us ki taaqat se zyada bojh nahin daalta, aur naap mein jo kami ya zyadati bina irade ke ho jaye, us par tum se mawakhiza nahin hoga. Aur isi tarah Us ne tumhein is se bhi roka hai ke koi waqia bayan karte waqt ya gawahi dete waqt jhoot bolo, aur kisi rishtedaar ya dost ki na-haqq taraf-daari karo. Aur Us ne tumhein Allah ka ahd todne se bhi roka hai. Agar tum Allah se koi ahd karo ya Allah ke naam par koi ahd karo, to aise ahd poore karne hi chahiyen. Allah ne tumhein yeh sab is umeed par bataya hai ke tum apne aamaal ke anjaam par gaur karo.
153: Aur Us ne tumhein gumraahi ke raaston par chalne se roka hai. Tum par laazim hai ke Allah ke seedhe raaste par chalo, jis mein koi tedhapan nahin. Gumraahi ke raaste tumhein haqq ke raaste se bahut door le jayenge. Allah tumhein seedhe raaste par chalne ka hukm is umeed par deta hai ke tum Us se daro: Us ke hukm par chalo aur Us ki mana ki hui cheezon se bacho.
154: Is sab ke baad Main tumhein yeh batata hoon ke Maine Moosa (alaihis salaam) ko Taurat di: apni naimat poori karne ke taur par aur un ke neik aamaal ka badla de kar, taake deen mein zaroori har baat wazeh ho jaye, aur rehmat ke taur par, is umeed par ke woh Qayamat ke din apne Rubb se milne par iman laayein aur neik aamaal se us ki tayyari karein.
155: Aur yeh Quran ek aisi kitab hai jo Maine utari, aur yeh barkaton se bhari hui hai, un deeni aur duniyavi faidon ki wajah se jo is mein hain. Lihaza us par chalo jo is mein utara gaya, aur is ke khilaaf jaane se bacho, is umeed par ke tum par reham kiya jaye.
156: Yeh kitab is liye utari gayi ke aey mushriko, tum yeh na kaho: Allah ne to Taurat aur Injeel sirf hum se pehle Yahood aur Nasara par utari, aur hum par koi kitab nahin utari. Aur hum un ki kitabein padhna nahin jaante, kyunke woh un ki zubaan mein hain, hamari zubaan mein nahin.
157: Aur isi tarah Maine yeh kitab is liye bheji ke tum yeh na kaho: agar Allah hum par koi kitab utarta, jaise Us ne Yahood aur Nasara par utari, to hum un se zyada seedhe raaste par hote. To ab Allah ne tumhare Nabi Muhammad ﷺ par tumhari apni zubaan mein kitab utar di hai: ek khuli daleel, hidayat aur poori ummat ke liye rehmat. Lihaza ab jhoote uzr na pesh karo aur is ke inkaar ke liye be-kaar wajhein na banao. Be-shak sab se bada zaalim woh shaks hai jo Allah ki aayaton ko jhutlaye aur un se munh mod le. Allah un logon ko sakht azaab dega jo Us ki aayaton se munh modte hain, aur unhein Jahannam ki aag mein daakhil karega: un se munh modne aur unhein nazar-andaaz karne ka badla.
158: Jo log haqq ko jhutlate hain, woh is ke siwa kisi cheez ka intezar nahin kar rahe ke maut ka farishta aur us ke madadgaar un ke paas aa kar duniya mein un ki jaanein nikaal lein; ya aey Rasool, un ka Rubb Aakhirat mein faisle ke din aa jaye taake un ka aakhiri faisla kare; ya un ke Rubb ki kuch nishaniyan aa jayein jo Qayamat ke qareeb aane ki khabar deti hain. Jis din aap ke Rubb ki kuch nishaniyan aa jayengi, jaise sooraj ka pachham se nikalna, us din kisi kafir ko us ka iman faida nahin dega, aur na us momin ko us ki neki jis ne pehle koi neki na ki thi. Aey Rasool, un mushrikon se keh dijiye jo ise jhutlate hain: 'In mein se kisi ek ka intezar karo; main bhi intezar kar raha hoon.'
159: Aey Rasool, un Yahood aur Nasara se aap ka koi taalluq nahin jinhon ne apna deen tukde tukde kar diya, us ka kuch hissa le liya aur kuch chhod diya, aur mukhtalif firqon mein bant gaye. Jo gumraahi unhon ne apnayi, us se aap bari hain. Aap ki zimmedaari sirf unhein daraana hai. Un ka maamla Allah ke hawale hai, aur phir Qayamat ke din Woh unhein bata dega ke woh duniya mein kya karte the aur un ka badla dega.
160: Momino mein se jo shaks Qayamat ke din ek neki laaye, Allah use us ke liye das guna kar dega. Aur jo koi burai laaye, use sirf usi ke barabar saza di jayegi, us se zyada nahin. Qayamat ke din un par zulm nahin hoga: na un ki nekiyon ke ajr mein kami ki jayegi aur na un ki buraiyon ki saza mein izafa.
161: Aey Rasool, in jhutlane wale mushrikon se keh dijiye: mere Rubb ne mujhe seedhe raaste ki hidayat di hai, jo us deen ka raasta hai jo duniya aur Aakhirat dono ki bhalai qayam karta hai. Yeh Ibrahim (alaihis salaam) ka deen hai, jo haqq ki taraf jhuke hue the aur jo kabhi un logon mein se nahin the jo Allah ke saath doosron ko sharik thehrate hain.
162: Aey Rasool, keh dijiye: meri namaz aur meri qurbani Allah ke liye aur Usi ke naam par hai, kisi aur ke liye nahin. Aur meri zindagi aur meri maut sirf Allah ke liye hai, jo tamam jahanon ka Rubb hai, aur is mein mere taraf se kisi aur ka koi hissa nahin.
163: Us ka, paak hai Woh, koi sharik nahin. Us ke siwa koi aur ibadat ke laayak nahin. Allah ne mujhe hukm diya hai ke main yahi khaalis tauheed qabool karoon, aur main is ummat mein sab se pehla hoon jo Us ke liye is ka iqrar karta hai.
164: Aey Rasool, in mushrikon se keh dijiye: kya main Allah ke siwa kisi aur ko Rubb talaash karoon, jab ke Wohi, paak hai Woh, har cheez ka Rubb hai? Wohi un cheezon ka bhi Rubb hai jin ki tum Us ke siwa ibadat karte ho. Aur koi be-gunah kisi doosre ka gunah nahin uthayega. Phir Qayamat ke din tumhara lautna sirf apne Rubb hi ki taraf hai, aur Woh tumhein un deeni baaton ki khabar dega jin mein tum duniya mein ikhtilaaf karte the.
165: Allah hi hai jis ne tumhein zameen par un logon ka janasheen banaya jo tum se pehle guzre, taake tum un ke baad is mein baso. Aur Us ne tum mein se kuch ko doosron par darje mein buland kiya, shakl mein, rozi mein aur doosri baaton mein, taake jo kuch Us ne tumhein diya hai us ke zariye tumhein aazmaye. Aey Rasool, aap ka Rubb insaaf ka faisla jald karne wala hai, kyunke jo cheez aane wali ho woh qareeb hi hoti hai. Aur Woh apne un bandon ke liye Bakhshne wala aur Meharban bhi hai jo Us ki taraf tauba karte hain.
